# SCI-RTC v0.1/r0.12 Scientific-Owner Freeze

Date: 2026-08-21

Owner: Grant Wilson

Owner statement:

> Freeze SCI-RTC v0.1/r0.12.

Status: Scientific authority frozen; implementation conformity not yet assessed
under this contract.

## Frozen authority

This owner statement promotes the verified candidate at commit
`ffce339abbb3c89ae1bf622c5395e28a5e727ea4` without scientific change. It
freezes SCI-RTC v0.1/r0.12 as the scientific authority for:

- the twelve-section science-team rationale and its six-file shared normative
  core;
- the engineering conformance view, whose view-specific material remains
  informative;
- the exact owner decisions and states in the decision ledger;
- the exact authority crosswalk and revision directive; and
- the two canonical frozen PDF artifacts recorded in `pdf/README.md`.

The frozen inventory is 52 definitions, 44 displayed equation tags, 12
assumptions, 143 requirements, 108 predictions, 24 author-draft decisions, and
103 owner entries. The 63 `OPEN`, one `CONDITIONAL`, 34 `RESOLVED`, and five
`DEFERRED` ledger states retain their exact recorded meanings and consequences.

## Claim boundary

This freeze establishes scientific authority only. It does not assert or
provide evidence of implementation conformity, representation fidelity,
validation, observational performance, science qualification, default
activation, production readiness, or production promotion. It does not choose
PTC or SCI-VAL policy and does not make any operation blocked by an open owner
entry available.

## Change control

The freeze is status-only. It changes no normative identifier, equation,
assumption, requirement, prediction, owner-ledger state, scientific meaning,
or unavailable-state consequence. Any future substantive correction, resolved
open choice, or changed scientific boundary requires explicit owner authority
and a versioned successor or formally reopened revision. Frozen r0.12 authority
must not be silently edited.
